body:
## What this service is

Radical Storage's Shinjuku page (`https://radicalstorage.com/luggage-storage/tokyo/shinjuku`) lets travelers pre-book luggage storage inside vetted local businesses—including hotels, cafés, and retail shops—around **Shinjuku Railway Station** in Tokyo. Because large station coin lockers in Shinjuku frequently fill up by mid-morning and cannot fit oversized suitcases, Radical Storage provides guaranteed space with **no size or weight limits**.

## Pricing and guarantee structure

When verified on 29 October 2026, the Shinjuku listing and its structured FAQ detailed the following pricing components:

- **Daily storage rate:** The Shinjuku FAQ states that daily storage prices start from **¥270 per day** depending on bag size (while the general Tokyo FAQ states **¥600 per day** and the page's JSON-LD Product offer lists **¥750 JPY**, with specific station points such as `luggage-storage-shinjuku-railway-station-2` displaying ¥850/day in their meta description).
- **Mandatory guarantee & support fee:** A **¥353 fee per bag** is added at checkout, which funds **¥2,000,000 in coverage per bag** against damage, theft, or loss, alongside 24/7 customer support.

## How check-in works and what is accepted

 Partner locations **do not accept walk-ins or cash payments**. You must book online via the Radical Storage website or app before arriving. Once booked, you receive a confirmation email containing the partner's exact street address and a digital QR code, which staff scan at both drop-off and pickup. Suitcases, backpacks, shopping bags, sports equipment, bicycles, and strollers are all accepted.

## Cancellation and modification policy

Bookings can be **modified any time up to drop-off** or **canceled free of charge any time before the scheduled check-in time** for a full refund.

## What to check before booking

Not every Shinjuku partner point is open 24/7 (for example, partner listing `#6459817` operates from 10:00 to 19:00 and closes on certain weekdays). Always check the specific partner's opening and closing hours on the map before completing checkout.
